remarks: Welcome to Wolfpit!!! This 3/4BD thoughtfully designed ranch style home located in one of Norwalk's most desirable neighborhoods comes w/flexible and functional layout and an excellent potential for an in-law setup; this home provides endless opportunities for expansion too. Enter into an open living room with centrally located fireplace w/fireplace insert for an added heating efficiency. The living wing on the right includes 2BDs with a gorgeous completely remodeled full BR. The entertaining wing on the left flows right into an open floor plan DR/kitchen area with direct access to one car attached garage (currently utilized as gym) and the stone patio. Large kitchen with generous size cabinets includes granite countertops and all stainless steel appliances. Kitchen flows into the family room w/office nook and the master BD wing with its own large master BR and a generous closet space plus its own independent access to the fabulous large tastefully designed stone patio and fully fenced flat yard perfect for summer BBQs and family/friends gatherings. AMAZING BONUS FINISHED HEATED ATTIC currently accessible via pull down stairs in the mechanical/laundry room ideal for home office, studio or addt'l living quarters. Propane heat and hot water!!! Central Air!!! Roof (2025). The 4th BD is currently utilized as a family room. Beautiful residential location close to shopping/restaurants, parks and only minutes to the Norwalk's fantastic Calf Pasture Beach. RARE Offering!!! Sold AS IS
